---
description: Show the current state of my Revibe learning journey
agent: revibe
---

Read `memory/MEMORY.md` and the active plan in `learning_plan/` (the file with `status: active` in its frontmatter, ignoring anything under `learning_plan/examples/`). Then give me a concise status report containing:

- The active plan title and topic.
- The current module and lesson.
- Date of my last session.
- A short list of concepts I've mastered so far.
- Any concepts in progress or recurring misconceptions.
- The single next thing we'll tackle when I run `/revibe-start`.

Do not change any files. Do not start a lesson. Do not give solution code.
